'''The Credit Chip''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] run by [[Cecil Vane]] on [[Sel Zonn Station]]. It offered a variety of games such as [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]], among others.
